<h1>Research</h1>
<p class="section-intro">My research focuses on local public finance, urban economics, and political economy.</p>
<h2>Papers</h2>
<div id="research-papers" class="paper-list" data-paper-list></div>
<script>
window.CW_PAPER_CONFIG = {
  mode: "list",
  target: "#research-papers",
  basePath: ""
};
(function loadPaperScripts(paths) {
  paths.reduce(function (chain, path) {
    return chain.then(function () {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        var script = document.createElement("script");
        script.src = path;
        script.onload = resolve;
        script.onerror = reject;
        document.body.appendChild(script);
      });
    });
  }, Promise.resolve());
})(["papers.js", "papers-render.js"]);
</script>
